title: Certified binary field implementation
statement: For an executable Vandermonde input with output dimension $n$, let $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. The field implementation assigns a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$: a vector of $\ell$ low coefficients over $\mathbb{F}_2$ whose associated monic polynomial is irreducible over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: Input has an independence order $k$ with $1\le k\le n$
